figurative_meaning_en: An extremely hardworking and multitasking woman
similar_in_english: A woman who juggles multiple tasks
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার স্ত্রী দশভুজা, একাই ঘরের সব কাজ সামলে নেয়।
এই অফিসের ম্যানেজার দশভুজা, সব দিক থেকে কাজ চালায়।
example_sentences_in_english: My wife is a ten-armed woman; she manages all household chores single-handedly.
The office manager is a ten-armed woman, handling everything efficiently.
history: Derived from the Hindu goddess Durga, who is depicted with ten arms symbolizing her divine power and ability to perform multiple actions simultaneously, often used to praise women's efficiency in Bengali culture.
note: The idiom draws from mythological imagery to highlight female capability in traditional roles.
